question: Can a high-resolution local RAD-DINO MIL branch recover small bone tumors while a frozen audited global branch preserves medium and large localization?

allowed_training_inputs: frozen RAD-DINO weights and spatial tokens
frozen global saliency generated without segmentation masks
forbidden_before_prediction_freeze: manual ROI, box, point, scribble or mask annotation
supervision_contract.validation_gt_use: read-only evaluation after both fused and local-only prediction maps, checkpoint, manifests and prediction_freeze.json are immutable

frozen_global_source.mount_contract: direct immutable kernel output; no copied or rediscovered duplicate evidence tree

diagnostic_basis.interpretation: global saliency is adequate for proposing local regions but its 64x64 prediction grid is inadequate for direct masks of many small tumors

global_branch.use_on_train_positive: generate content-aligned coarse saliency for ROI proposal
global_branch.use_on_train_normal: none; normal ROI windows are deterministic seeded random windows
global_branch.use_on_validation: load and hash-verify all 371 already frozen global maps

roi_proposals.geometry: content-aligned 320x320 coordinates mapped proportionally to the original radiograph before local crop padding
roi_proposals.positive_train_selection: six greedy highest-saliency-mass diverse windows from frozen global map
roi_proposals.validation_selection: three greedy highest-saliency-mass diverse windows from each frozen global map

local_decoder.bag_pool: mean of top 1% valid logits across all patches and pixels

train_normal_confidence_calibration.statistic: p99 of local bag probability over clean-train normal images

prediction.local_tta: mean of original and aligned horizontal flip
prediction.local_stitch: bilinear ROI resize with arithmetic mean in overlap
prediction.primary_arm: frozen global map plus confidence-gated sparse local residual
prediction.local_only_arm: diagnostic only; cannot be selected as primary after GT

fixed_metrics: image-level AUROC from fused raw foreground p99 over all 371 images
Dice at p90, p95, p97 and p99
complete misses at every Dice threshold
evaluation.baseline: frozen multi-layer soft-region global v3 evaluation/per_image.csv
evaluation.comparison: paired complete-group bootstrap, 10000 replicates, seed family 20260901

gate.pass_action: authorize only design of a separately predeclared size-balanced pseudo-mask consumer; do not train automatically
gate.fail_action: reject this exact global-local configuration without post-hoc retuning

literature_basis.citation: Chen and Sun, Weakly-supervised Semantic Segmentation with Image-level Labels: From Traditional Models to Foundation Models, ACM Computing Surveys 57(5), 2025
literature_basis.transferred_principle: separate image-label localization, refinement and consumer stages

literature_basis.citation: Mun et al., Small Objects Matters in Weakly-supervised Semantic Segmentation, WACV 2024, 413-422
literature_basis.transferred_principle: per-size evaluation and preservation of large-object knowledge; component weighting deferred until pseudo-components are trustworthy

literature_basis.citation: Liu et al., Weakly-supervised High-resolution Segmentation of Mammography Images for Breast Cancer Diagnosis, PMLR 143:268-285, 2021
literature_basis.transferred_principle: global proposal, local high-resolution image-label MIL, six train patches and fewer inference patches

literature_basis.citation: Zhang et al., Frozen CLIP: A Strong Backbone for Weakly Supervised Semantic Segmentation, CVPR 2024, 3796-3806
literature_basis.transferred_principle: frozen foundation backbone plus lightweight spatial decoder and refinement

literature_basis.citation: Yang et al., Anomaly-guided weakly supervised lesion segmentation on retinal OCT images, Medical Image Analysis 94:103139, 2024
literature_basis.transferred_principle: normal/anomaly evidence for small medical-lesion localization
